column6: Stars spread out and fill the sky.
Cold and heat follow one another.
Sun and moon fill
Harvest in autumn
Leap months complete the year.
Pitch pipes harmonize the yang.
Clouds rise and become rain.
Dew freezes into white frost.
Gold comes from the Li waters.
Jade comes from Kunlun's slopes.
The sword Juque is the most famous of blades.
Among pearls
column7: Night Glow is the famed one.

column6: Plums and crabapples are the prized fruits.
Mustard greens and ginger matter among vegetables.
The sea is salty
Scaled fish dive
Fuxi named offices by dragons
Shaohao named offices by birds; the Human Sovereign ruled.
Writing was first created.
Then came upper and lower garments.
Thrones were yielded and realms ceded.
Shun of Youyu and Yao of Taotang.
King Wu of Zhou and Tang of Shang.
Hold court and ask after the way.
Rule at ease; all is ordered and bright.
Cherish and raise the common people.
Make the Rong and Qiang submit.
Far and near become one body.
Lead all to pledge to the king.
The phoenix calls in the tree.
